name: Castelnovo ne' Monti (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Castelnovo ne' Monti (three stars above a stag on light blue and green).
history: Municipal flag of Castelnovo ne' Monti, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Castelnovo ne' Monti arms — three stars above a stag, crowned
